name: Sol-fa-soft Manatsu no Okiraku CD
source:
This is a sol-fa-soft Variety CD sold in the summer of 2010.

■ Spot the difference
It's a mini game, spot 5 differences to get a CG.

■ Game Center Hanjouki
It is a short story about playing with a girl in an arcade.

■ Omatsuri no Tsuzuki
It's a short story. This is a sequel to "Yukata no Shita wa ...".
